tutorial.title: Gameplay Tutorial
tutorial.description: Learn the basics of Food RPG.
pages: Welcome to Food RPG. In this game, you build and manage your own food business.
Your business is the heart of your game. You will make decisions, manage resources, complete activities, and grow your business over time.
Use the Up and Down arrow keys to move between menu options. Use Enter or Space to activate the selected option.
Some controls, such as combo boxes, use the Left and Right arrow keys to change their values. When a combo box is opened, use Up and Down to select an option and Enter or Space to confirm it.
You can open your game details to view information about your current day, time, location, objective, and activity.
The Options menu contains game settings such as speech backend, speech verbosity, speech volume, and speech rate.
You can pause the game while viewing the gameplay options. Choose Continue to return to the game.
Your business options depend on the type of business you selected when creating your game.
Food RPG is designed to be played through menus, speech, and keyboard controls. Take your time and explore the options available to you.
Tutorial complete. Your game is ready to begin.
